title: Trace the Ball
description: A defender mirrors the ball with one hand as the offensive player moves it high, low and side to side from triple threat — keeping hands active without fouling.

content.objective: Keep a hand on the ball's path (tracing) to bother shots and passes without reaching in.
content.setup: Pairs face each other one arm-length apart; the offensive player holds the ball.
instructions: The offensive player moves the ball slowly: overhead, to each hip, to each side.
The defender traces the ball with the nearest hand, palm facing it, without touching.
The offensive player adds pass fakes.
coachingPoints: Hand follows the ball like a shadow.
Stay in a stance; feet stay quiet.
commonMistakes: Reacting to fakes with the whole body.
content.safety: No contact with the ball handler's arms.
progressions: Add a pass to a third player; defender tries to deflect.
variations: Trace a dribbler at walking speed.
Trace while a partner shoots a set shot.
successCriteria: Hand stays on the ball's path for 30 seconds.
content.gameApplication: Tracing the ball after the dribble stops makes passes difficult and leads to turnovers.
